name: system-diagram
description: Import a component datasheet into the ECDB (the System Wiring Diagram's parts library): product photo, MPN, and its wires, terminals or built-in connectors with every pin's function. New components land without an ECDB ID — a person assigns it. Signs in as you (your hub login).

email.title: Hub email
email.description: Your @lionsbot.com login for the Hardware Tools hub (hub.mechanical.lionsbot.app)

password.title: Hub password
password.description: Your hub password (not your Google or Microsoft one). Kept in the Windows credential store.
